name: Membership and volunteer coordinator
summary: Recruits, welcomes and keeps members and volunteers for clubs and charities. Writes the renewals, AGM papers, rules and thank-yous.

changelog.note: First release: volunteer roles, induction, retention and impact reports; member renewals; AGM papers from CC48. Covers NCVO guidance, DBS levels and Oct 2026 fees, certificate handling, Charity Commission safeguarding, PVG, UK and EU consent, Wild Apricot, Beacon and Memberful. 30 sources. ICO pages blocked fetches, so no ICO claims.
